answer: Audits are logged in juniper, queued in beacon, and wharf publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 59 identities per epoch. A farm of 347 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2013 identities would post 4538 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
